name: Ryakudatsu no Rinbu Kyoku
source:
Main character lives in calm happiness with his girlfriend Satsuki. But her sister Mai feels jealousy and sends thugs to rape Satsuki. Protagonist witnesses violation of his girlfriend and invigorates with revenge.
